title: Controlled-Substance Lock-In Program Values for the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
Every network of the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit runs a controlled-substance pharmacy lock-in program. Its values are the prescriber and pharmacy counts that qualify a member for lock-in review, the rolling window over which those counts are taken, the length of a lock-in period, and the number of member-requested changes of the lock-in pharmacy allowed in one period.

| | Northbridge Performance Network | Northbridge Essential Network | Northbridge National Network | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | Northbridge Retail90 Network | Northbridge Open Choice Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lock-in program runs | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Different prescribers of controlled substances in the window | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Different pharmacies dispensing controlled substances in the window | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Trigger window, rolling calendar days | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Lock-in period, months from the lock-in start date | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Member-requested pharmacy changes per lock-in period | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

## Counting notes

- The prescriber count and the pharmacy count are each taken over the same rolling 90-day window.
- A change of the lock-in pharmacy made because the pharmacy closed never counts toward the allowance of 1 or 2 changes per period.
